ok.speaker: narrator
ok.text: The ward patient grips your arm. "Pell said someone was talking on the intercom. Was that you? Thank you. We'll follow the doctor to the bays."

rushed.speaker: narrator
rushed.text: The patient coughs, eyes streaming from the coolant still hanging in the air. "We're out. We're out. Thank you."

choices.text: Keep moving. The air's better forward.
